verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own approval workflows: rules-based routing of requests to stakeholders by vendor type, spend category, or dollar amount; workflows keyed to spend amount or team role; and approval workflows as part of the spend-controls layer across cards, reimbursements, bills, and agent purchases. None of this evidence shows explicit sequential multi-step chains (manager → budget owner → finance), approver delegation, or time-based escalation when approvers sit on requests. The AI agent's "escalates when it's not [safe]" refers to risk flagging, not approver escalation. Missing for 10: explicitly documented multi-step sequential approval chains, approver delegation/out-of-office reassignment, escalation or reminders for stalled approvals, independent corroboration.
